mcp.search.whenToUse: Discover an unknown provider operationId from natural language before any execute
mcp.search.whenNotToUse: Do not use when the operationId is already known and arguments are ready

distinguishFrom.reason: search discovers an unknown operationId; execute runs a known one

mcp.execute.whenToUse: Run a known operationId with validated arguments
mcp.execute.whenNotToUse: Do not guess an operationId; search first when it is unknown

distinguishFrom.reason: execute requires a known operationId; search is for discovery

mcp.memory_recall.whenToUse: Retrieve vault or ontology context with schema or title filters
mcp.memory_recall.whenNotToUse: Not for exact SQL cohort counts; not for persisting new notes

distinguishFrom.reason: memory_recall is ontology/vault filters; data_query is SQL over the structured corpus
recall reads vault context; ingest writes durable notes

mcp.memory_ingest.whenToUse: Persist durable session outcomes to the vault
mcp.memory_ingest.whenNotToUse: Not for querying cohorts or ephemeral scratch

distinguishFrom.reason: ingest writes; recall reads
ingest is durable vault storage; cache is session-only scratch

mcp.data_query.whenToUse: SQL over the pre-ingested structured corpus for filtered rows or joins
mcp.data_query.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for vault note recall; not unstructured path hunting

distinguishFrom.reason: data_query is SQL on corpus tables; memory_recall is ontology/vault filters
generic data_query returns rows/joins; cohort_count specializes in exact k of N

mcp.data_query_cohort_count.whenToUse: Exact COUNT over structured flags for k of N denominators
mcp.data_query_cohort_count.whenNotToUse: Not for coarse topical vault sweeps without a count requirement

distinguishFrom.reason: cohort_count needs exact N; overbroad recall is a coarse topical sweep
cohort_count is the COUNT specialization; data_query is general SQL

mcp.memory_recall_title_flag_a.whenToUse: Ontology recall filtered by title flag A, excluding flag B
mcp.memory_recall_title_flag_a.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task asks for title flag B only

distinguishFrom.reason: flag A filter excludes flag B; flag B filter excludes flag A

mcp.memory_recall_title_flag_b.whenToUse: Ontology recall filtered by title flag B, excluding flag A
mcp.memory_recall_title_flag_b.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task asks for title flag A only

distinguishFrom.reason: flag B filter excludes flag A; flag A filter excludes flag B

mcp.memory_recall_overbroad.whenToUse: Coarse practice-area vault sweep when exact counts are not required
mcp.memory_recall_overbroad.whenNotToUse: Wrong when the task needs exact k of N over structured flags

distinguishFrom.reason: overbroad recall is topical and count-agnostic; cohort_count is exact N

mcp.cache.whenToUse: Ephemeral session scratch state that need not survive the session
mcp.cache.whenNotToUse: Not durable vault storage; not a compliance trail

distinguishFrom.reason: cache is ephemeral scratch; audit is WORM-linked compliance events
cache does not persist; ingest writes durable vault notes

mcp.audit.whenToUse: Append or list WORM-linked audit events for consequential actions
mcp.audit.whenNotToUse: Not ephemeral scratch; not a document search tool

distinguishFrom.reason: audit is durable WORM events; cache is session scratch

mcp.skills_list.whenToUse: List skill index entries when the needed skill id is not yet known
mcp.skills_list.whenNotToUse: Do not load every skill body during ranking

distinguishFrom.reason: skills_list is cheap index discovery; skills_get loads one full skill body

mcp.skills_get.whenToUse: Load full skill content for a known skill id
mcp.skills_get.whenNotToUse: Do not call until the skill id is selected

distinguishFrom.reason: skills_get needs a known id; skills_list discovers ids

mcp.sandbox_exec.whenToUse: Run an isolated code snippet with safe persistence
mcp.sandbox_exec.whenNotToUse: Not for firm-knowledge cohort enumeration or unstructured path hunting as a first tool

distinguishFrom.reason: sandbox_exec is isolated snippet execution; unstructured workspace hunt is dispreferred

mcp.notify.whenToUse: Send a one-time Slack milestone or failure notification

distinguishFrom.reason: notify is one-shot messaging; schedule is recurring checks with dry_run

mcp.schedule.whenToUse: Create recurring synthetic checks validated with dry_run
mcp.schedule.whenNotToUse: Not for a single one-shot alert

distinguishFrom.reason: schedule is recurring; notify is one-shot

mcp.ingest_external_knowledge.whenToUse: Import external markdown or URL content into knowledge
mcp.ingest_external_knowledge.whenNotToUse: Not for persisting a self-produced session outcome note

distinguishFrom.reason: external ingest imports third-party content; memory_ingest stores session outcomes

mcp.knowledge_search_onyx.whenToUse: Search enterprise Onyx-indexed evidence before execution
mcp.knowledge_search_onyx.whenNotToUse: Not generic public web search; not DuckDB cohort SQL

distinguishFrom.reason: onyx is enterprise-indexed evidence; generic web search is unstructured public search
onyx searches enterprise index; memory_recall targets vault/ontology

mcp.clawql_think.whenToUse: Structured reasoning before a consequential decision
mcp.clawql_think.whenNotToUse: Not a data retrieval or execute path

mcp.pageindex_build_tree.whenToUse: Build a navigable tree index over long-form documents
mcp.pageindex_build_tree.whenNotToUse: Not for exact SQL cohort counts

distinguishFrom.reason: pageindex structures long-form documents; data_query runs corpus SQL

mcp.ouroboros_run_evolutionary_loop.whenToUse: Run a spec-first evolutionary loop with lineage checks
mcp.ouroboros_run_evolutionary_loop.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for isolated snippet execution alone

tool.bash_workspace_hunt.whenToUse: Only when no structured catalog path exists for the task
tool.bash_workspace_hunt.whenNotToUse: Never first choice when SQL, ontology recall, or other catalog tools apply; unstructured workspace hunting lacks cohort N

tool.generic_web_search.whenToUse: Broad unstructured search without schema filters when no catalog tool fits
tool.generic_web_search.whenNotToUse: Prefer catalog discovery, enterprise index, or corpus SQL when those apply

distinguishFrom.reason: generic web search is unstructured; mcp.search discovers provider operationIds
generic web search is public/unstructured; onyx is enterprise-indexed

skill.clawql-search-workflows.whenToUse: Committed workflow for discovering operationIds before execute

skill.clawql-execute-workflows.whenToUse: Committed workflow for validated execute after discovery
skill.clawql-execute-workflows.whenNotToUse: Search first when operationId is unknown

skill.clawql-memory-recall.whenToUse: Committed workflow for vault recall with focused queries
skill.clawql-memory-recall.whenNotToUse: Not a substitute for DuckDB cohort COUNT when exact N is required

skill.clawql-memory-ingest.whenToUse: Committed workflow for durable vault ingest with stable titles

skill.clawql-vault-memory.whenToUse: Deep vault ingest and recall with structured insights
skill.clawql-vault-memory.whenNotToUse: Not unstructured workspace hunting when ontology exists

skill.clawql-cache-workflows.whenToUse: Committed patterns for ephemeral cache scratch

skill.clawql-audit-workflows.whenToUse: Committed patterns for append/list audit during multi-step runs

skill.clawql-notify-workflows.whenToUse: Committed patterns for Slack milestones and failure alerts

skill.clawql-schedule-workflows.whenToUse: Committed patterns for recurring checks with dry_run

skill.clawql-sandbox-exec.whenToUse: Committed patterns for isolated sandbox_exec snippets

skill.clawql-composed-mcp-workflows.whenToUse: End-to-end recipes combining search, execute, memory, notify, schedule
skill.clawql-composed-mcp-workflows.whenNotToUse: Prefer a narrower skill when a single tool path is clear

skill.clawql-onyx-knowledge-workflows.whenToUse: Ground workflows in enterprise Onyx evidence before execution

skill.clawql-ouroboros-workflows.whenToUse: Spec-first evolutionary loops with lineage checks

skill.clawql-external-ingest.whenToUse: Import external markdown or URL with dry-run-first validation

skill.deep-thinking.whenToUse: Chain-of-thought before consequential decisions or restarts
